summary.bn: সামনে কিছু নড়লে আউটপুট HIGH হয়, আর কিছুক্ষণ HIGH থাকে।
summary.en: Its output goes high when something warm moves, and stays high for a while.

simplified: Movement is switched on and off by hand. Distance, direction and how warm the thing is do not matter.
It works as soon as it has power. A real one needs about a minute first, and may give false signals in that time.
The jumper is taken to be in the "repeat" position: more movement keeps the output high.
After its output falls it ignores movement for 2.5 seconds. Sellers' datasheets do not agree on this time, nor on the range of the hold-time trimmer.
The sensitivity trimmer is left out.
